relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a male with a LAMP2 nonsense variant: 'whole exome sequencing identified a hemizygous stop gain variant (c.C329C>A: p.S110X chrX:120455425G>T) in the lysosome-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP-2) gene'.
method_note: Hand-read; built with a short Python script in the scratch directory (no table transcription; the paper has no tables). Label 'patient' (rule 5; 'Our patient' is a role word). The father is included as a relative described in relation to the patient (sudden cardiac death at 52); he was not tested and no LAMP2 status is given, so he has no variant row and all checklist items are not reported. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null (paper says nothing about earlier reports). Variant printed in non-standard form 'c.C329C>A' (reference base inside the position); recorded as printed; no transcript or genome build printed. Variant type 'nonsense' maps the authors' 'stop gain'. Pathogenicity 'causative, novel' from the Conclusions and Discussion. Age at onset 'second decade of life' comes from the Discussion sentence about palpitations; dysphagia onset is given only as a duration ('for the past eight years') and palpitations as 'five years ago', so no ISO age. Vital status left not reported (not stated). Checklist: left ventricular hypertrophy marked observed from apical HCM on echocardiogram and 'concentric hypertrophy' with 22 mm maximal wall thickness on cardiac MRI; ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation excluded from 'no significant ventricular arrhythmias' on Holter; intellectual disability/cognitive impairment/learning difficulties excluded from 'normal cognition' plus 'normal scholastic performance'. Proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy) left not reported: proximal weakness is explicitly absent, but the patient has neck extensor weakness, muscle MRI changes and elevated CK, so the broader 'skeletal myopathy' part is not excluded (narrow-vs-broad rule). Normal investigations as a whole (complete hemogram, basic metabolic panel, viral and autoimmune markers) recorded as written, excluding nothing more specific; 'vital signs were within normal limits' and 'The rest of his neurologic examination was unremarkable' not recorded as features; 'no diurnal variation' not recorded as a feature. Abstract statements ('laboratory investigations were unremarkable', 'Clinical examination was significant only for neck extensor muscle weakness') not used to exclude checklist items. No contradictions found in the paper.
